Metadata.descricao: Urban complaint platform by municipality, with AI-assisted content moderation.

TermosModal.linkTexto: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy

Termos.aviso: This document is a draft prepared for capstone project (TCC) purposes and does not replace professional legal advice. Before any real-world use of the platform, review by a data protection lawyer is recommended.
Termos.secao1Paragrafo1: By creating an account on Urban Grid, you agree to provide truthful information, not to publish offensive, defamatory, fraudulent content or content outside the scope of urban problems in your city, and to take responsibility for the content you publish. Using the platform to create fake accounts, coordinate bad-faith mass reports, or artificially manipulate public perception of any person, department, or political group is prohibited and may result in account suspension.
Termos.secao1Paragrafo2: All submitted content goes through an automated moderation pipeline and, when necessary, human review, before being published. Complaints and reports may be rejected, archived, or have the author suspended in case of misuse, according to the criteria described publicly in the project's repository.
Termos.secao2Paragrafo1: We collect only the data necessary for the platform to work: name, email, national ID / CPF (stored only as a hash, never as plain text), phone (optional), and, when you attach photos to a complaint, the uploaded images and their technical metadata.
Termos.secao2Paragrafo2: This data is used for authentication, preventing duplicate or fake accounts, communicating about the progress of your complaints, and auditing the moderation pipeline. Images go through automatic face and license plate detection, with blurring applied before publication.
Termos.secao2Paragrafo3: You have the right, at any time, to access, correct, or delete your personal data through the "My account" page. Deleting your account anonymizes your personal data; complaints already published are kept as a public-interest record for the city, without identifying the author.

Moderacao.desfoquePendenteDesc: Automatic blurring failed on at least one photo in this complaint (face or license plate detected). Approving is blocked until this is resolved — reject it if you can't fix the image.

Footer.termos: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy

Home.subtitulo: Report urban problems in your city, track the responsible department's official response, and confirm when the problem is truly resolved.
Home.jaTemConta: Already have an account? Log in
Home.comoFuncionaSub: From filing to confirmation, every step is public and auditable.
Home.passo1Desc: Describe the urban problem in your neighborhood — potholes, lighting, garbage collection, and more — with photos if you'd like.
Home.passo2Desc: Every complaint goes through automated content checks before going live publicly.
Home.passo3Desc: The responsible department responds officially and updates the problem's status.
Home.passo4Desc: Rate whether the problem was truly resolved — your rating feeds into the city's public index.
Home.acontecendoAgoraSub: The most recent complaints filed on the platform, in real time.
Home.diferenteSub: A direct channel between citizens and public departments, with transparency at every step.
Home.diferencial1Desc: Text and images go through automated checks — offensive content, spam, personal data, reposting — before anything is published.
Home.diferencial2Desc: Each department has a public badge (Great, Good, Fair, Poor), calculated from response time and actual resolution rate.
Home.diferencial3Desc: Confirm problems that affect you too, and comment on any complaint — with moderation and a human review queue.
Home.diferencial4Desc: Two-factor authentication via authenticator app, a unique national ID per account, and email verification.
Home.melhorAvaliadosSub: Public badge calculated from response time and actual resolution rate — no self-assessment.
